items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Which you did with Stephen Smith... We were partners in the Hot Record Exchange.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's at Dandy Inn. Out on the Jefferson Davis Parkway. Big barn like place. But otherwise I didn't spend much time here until 1942 about.

Well, there's a chapter in Jasmine called New Orleans Music. Yeah. Which you did with Stephen Smith. I think you did that. Now, how did you and he decide to do it together? And how did your research? I don't know who suggested that we do it together.

Steve is much interested in New Orleans Music too, of course. We were partners in the Hot Record Exchange. So, actually at that time he got the idea of opening a store then, a retail store, which didn't open until 1939. Right. But he was very busy organizing things. And actually didn't have time really to work on that chapter except his wife did most of the work and she did a lot of the research. Steve and she would go around and interview people. I'd made a couple of trips to Chicago. We even got an advance. I…
